notes.title: Update 0.22.0
notes.notes:
Hello, players! At long last, the silver-haired head maid, Sakuya Izayoi, makes her debut in Dreamy Duels with the release of version 0.22.0! With her power to manipulate time, Sakuya excels at drawing cards quickly and reducing their cost, allowing her to unleash a flurry of plays in a single turn to seize victory.

For detailed update information, please visit our official website: https://thg.igsk.fun/

notes.title: Update 0.21.0
notes.notes:
Hello, players! In this update, we've added the ability to copy buffs when duplicating cards. We hope this will reduce the workload when creating a large number of buff-related cards. Additionally, we've supplemented events related to changes in buff properties.

For detailed update information, please visit our official website: https://thg.igsk.fun/

notes.title: Update 0.20.0
notes.notes:
Hello, players! Long time no see. In this update, we’ve added a Popularity Mode to the Workshop's card pool rankings. This mode considers the recency and relevance of positive ratings to showcase the latest and most popular card pools, ensuring that older, highly-rated pools no longer dominate the rankings indefinitely.

Additionally, we’ve introduced several new nodes related to events and mapping sets, giving players more tools to create unique cards!

Event-related nodes include:
[list]
[*] Retrieving a sub-event or parent event of a given event
[*] Identifying the event chain that an event belongs to
[*] Tracking events triggered during and after the occurrence of a specific event
[/list]

These enhancements will allow players to fine-tune their card effects and chain reactions more effectively, enabling deeper DIY customization.

For detailed update information, please visit our official website: https://thg.igsk.fun/

notes.title: Version 0.19.0
notes.notes:
Hello, players! Long time no see! In our last update, we introduced the in-game Workshop. This time, we're adding even more exciting features: the "Top-Rated Leaderboard" and "Homebrew Mode." Now, you can rate custom cards by dueling with other players!

You can create a Homebrew Mode room in the online lobby. In this mode, you can include up to 5 custom cards published in the Workshop in your deck. These custom cards will be displayed to your opponent at the start of the game, and after the match, you'll have the opportunity to give them a thumbs-up or thumbs-down. Gather your friends for thrilling duels and let everyone know which custom cards are the most popular in the Workshop!

For detailed update information, please visit our official website: https://thg.igsk.fun/

notes.title: Hotfix 0.18.3
notes.notes:
[h1]Editor[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where, after setting the card or buff image and saving the card pool, the image path would be incorrect, leading to the inability to upload to the Workshop or re-import the card pool. For card pools that have already encountered this error, re-saving the card pool will fix the related errors.
[*] Fixed issues where the Action Editor and Rule Editor were unusable.
[*] Fixed an issue where card pools in the new format could not be used for online games.
[/list]

[h1]Cards[/h1]
[list]
[] Changed the trigger timing in the descriptions of Minoriko Aki and Shizuha Aki from "after the end of the turn" to "at the end of the turn".
[] Fixed an issue where Arcane Knowledge would reveal non-spell cards.
[*] Fixed an issue in the classic card pool where Letty Whiterock's effect would be canceled within the same turn after the player used a skill.
[/list]

[h1]Battle[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the hero's current health would be reduced by double the value the first time their health decreases without taking damage.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.18.0
notes.notes:
In version 0.18.0 of Dreamy Duels, we are excited to introduce an epic new feature—the in-game Workshop! Now, you no longer need to share your custom cards with other players through file transfers. Simply upload your card pool to the Workshop, and it will be available for others to browse and download! This is just the beginning; we plan to introduce rating systems and more to foster a robust custom card environment. Additionally, we've added an effect color palette and effect preview to the editor, allowing you to customize the colors of various effects and create even more share-worthy cards!

For detailed update information, please visit our official website: https://thg.igsk.fun/

notes.title: Hotfix 0.17.3
notes.notes:
Editor:

    Fixed an issue where card pools could not be imported correctly.
    Fixed a problem where audio files with uppercase extensions were not recognized.

Other:

    Fixed an issue where the game could not be launched if the host name contained Chinese characters; now a prompt will appear.

notes.title: Version 0.17.2
notes.notes:
Hello players, the long-awaited version 0.17.2 of "Dreamy Duel" is here! You can now set custom sound effects for your custom cards! As the card pool grows, so does its size. Therefore, to ensure a good experience with custom cards now and in the future, we've upgraded the card pool file format, significantly reducing its size.

We have improved the UI related to keywords. Now, in the editor, keyword-related nodes can be selected from a dropdown menu of preset keywords. Additionally, during deck building and battles, hovering over a card will display detailed explanations of the keywords.

This update also introduces new cards and mechanics for Reisen. Reisen has gained the unique ability to summon illusions of minions on the field, and opponents cannot distinguish between the illusion and the original. We have also made balance adjustments to Reisen's previously released cards. For more details on the update, please visit our official website.
